title: Neural Image Compression with Internal-External Prior Fusion and Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.07644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing context models for learned image com- pression rely primarily on internal priors from the current image, overlooking common patterns and typical textures shared across natural images. To address this limitation, we propose an Internal-External Prior Fusion-Alignment (IE-PFA) context model built upon quadtree spatial-channel joint modeling, where a learnable dictionary shared by the encoder and decoder serves as an external prior. Specifically, an RWKV-based Spatial- Channel Prior Fusion (RSCPF) module efficiently fuses inter- nal and external priors along spatial and channel dimensions with linear complexity, while a training-only Self-Distilled Prior Alignment (SDPA) mechanism aligns them without inference overhead. Moreover, our model supports variable-rate coding over 64 quality levels within a single network and is accelerated by custom CUDA operators. translated_title: 基于内外先验融合与对齐的神经图像压缩
translated_abstract: 现有用于学习型图像压缩的上下文模型主要依赖当前图像的内部先验，忽略了自然图像之间共享的常见模式和典型纹理。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种建立在四叉树空间-通道联合建模之上的内外先验融合与对齐上下文模型，其中由编码器和解码器共享的可学习字典充当外部先验。具体而言，基于RWKV的空间-通道先验融合模块以线性复杂度在空间和通道维度上高效融合内部与外部先验，而仅用于训练的自蒸馏先验对齐机制在完成对齐的同时不引入任何推理开销。此外，我们的模型在单一网络中即可支持跨越64个质量级别的可变码率编码，并通过自定义CUDA算子实现加速。在七个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法取得了最先进的率失真性能。
tldr: 该论文提出内外先验融合与对齐（IE-PFA）上下文模型，利用共享可学习字典作为外部先验，与图像内部先验融合并对齐，在单网络内支持64级可变码率编码，实现最先进的率失真性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Internal-External Prior Fusion-Alignment (IE-PFA) context model that fuses internal image priors with a learnable external dictionary shared between encoder and decoder, achieving state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance while supporting variable-rate coding over 64 quality levels in a single network.
